evidence.evidence_text: Our approach demonstrates superior performance on the KaggleDBQA dataset, designed to evaluate generalizability for the Text-to-SQL task.
Cross-domain and cross-compositional generalization of Text-to-SQL semantic parsing is a challenging task.
This allows for synthesis of a fixed Generic Prompt (GP), with a diverse set-of exemplars common across NL test queries, avoiding expensive test time exemplar retrieval.
